Is there a MINIMUM number of players for a tournament in the current
V:EKN Tournament Rules (2010 Season or earlier)?

I cant find it anywhere.

(I know the game is better with 4 or 5 players, but as i asked: there
is a minimum? or a maximum?)

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 1 Jan 2010 06:57:20 -0800 (PST), Smiling Jack XXX wrote:

>Is there a MINIMUM number of players for a tournament in the current
>V:EKN Tournament Rules (2010 Season or earlier)?

Minimumm number for what?
Per table? 4
Ratings? 4
TWDA? 10
Miniqualifier? 12

>I cant find it anywhere.

>(I know the game is better with 4 or 5 players, but as i asked: there
>is a minimum? or a maximum?)

4 players per table minimum, with the number of 5 player tables
maximized.

See also:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=veknRules.html

section 3.1.2

The judge will randomly and impartially assign players in groups of
five. In the event that the number of players is not evenly divisible
by five, the judge will assign players in groups of four and five,
such that as many groups as possible contain five players.

If the players cannot be divided into groups of 4 and 5 (i.e., there
are 6, 7, or 11 players), then the judge may elect to use a seating
arrangement in which some players sit out each round (while still
ensuring that every player plays the same number of games, usually
equal to one less than the number of rounds).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jan 1, 9:57 am, Smiling Jack XXX <Smiling-J...@lycos.com> wrote:
> Is there a MINIMUM number of players for a tournament in the current
> V:EKN Tournament Rules (2010 Season or earlier)?

4.

> I cant find it anywhere.

http://white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=veknRules.html#sec3.1.2

> (I know the game is better with 4 or 5 players, but as i asked: there
> is a minimum? or a maximum?)

Every table in a tournament has to have 4 or 5 players. Therefore 4 is
the minimum number of players necessary for a tournament. The maximum
per table is 5. There is no maximum for the tournament as a whole.
